judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The used-car-salesman patter (granny who only sliced cheese, 250 down to 90, 'another fellow asking after this one') is exactly Westwood's cheeky shopkeeper humour, with short lines and a casual 'Here ya go!'. The cheaper-rival-shop setup is slightly neat, but nothing reads as padded or modern.
